title: AION 2 NotMeter: Setup and DPS Records
description: Find the NotMeter maintainer, understand its published Windows setup and read DPS records with Global compatibility and NC policy limits clearly stated.
summary: Follow the maintainer’s current distribution link, check your region and version, and compare similar fights. Global desktop compatibility and NC approval are not verified here.
quickAnswer: Start at notmeter.com and follow its current release link; the maintainer lists Npcap, ZIP extraction and NotMeter.exe. Global website search is available, but this guide has not verified desktop compatibility with the current Global patch.
